seo.title: AstroTYPO3: TYPO3 and Astro Visual Builder
seo.description: AI powered visual website builder with a TYPO3 extension and an Astro frontend, connected by a shared content contract.

props.heading: Build websites visually with TYPO3 and Astro
props.subheading: TYPO3 manages structured content. Astro renders it fast. AI proposes validated changes, never unchecked code.

items.title: TYPO3 extension
items.text: Pages, permissions, revisions, content API, preview tokens and publishing in PHP.

items.title: Astro frontend
items.text: Server rendered routes, design tokens, SEO output and the editing bridge.

items.title: Shared contract
items.text: One registry and JSON schemas keep PHP and TypeScript in sync.

items.title: Visual builder
items.text: Drag, reorder, inspect and edit properties in the browser.

items.title: Template library
items.text: Presets, sections, pages and a full agency starter site.

items.title: Safe AI layer
items.text: Mock provider by default. Change plans are allowlisted and validated.

props.heading: How the demo works
props.text: This homepage is rendered from a fixture page that follows the same contract the TYPO3 API returns. Switch the content source to a live TYPO3 endpoint by setting TYPO3_CONTENT_API_URL.

items.question: Is the AI live in this demo?
items.answer: No. The demo endpoints use a clearly labelled mock provider. Connect a real provider server side in TYPO3 or in the Astro endpoint.

items.question: Can drafts leak publicly?
items.answer: No. Public routes only load published pages. Draft routes require a preview token.

items.question: Does Astro run inside TYPO3?
items.answer: No. They are separate applications connected by a versioned content API.
